name: Huge Shark
appearance: A great white-like shark that can exceed 20 feet in length. It has a heavy body, dark gray back, white underside, a tall triangular dorsal fin and a crescent-shaped tail.

combat.attackOptions: Space 15 ft. and reach 10 ft. Both the attack and full attack are a single Bite.

Trait.name: Blindsense (Ex)
Trait.effectNote: While underwater, the shark can locate creatures underwater within 30 ft. Blindsense alone does not remove concealment.

Trait.name: Keen Scent (Ex)
Trait.effectNote: The shark detects creatures by scent within 180 ft. and blood in the water up to 1 mile away.

Trait.name: Aquatic subtype
Trait.effectNote: The shark breathes water and cannot breathe air. Ordinary swimming takes no Swim check.

Trait.name: Swim
Trait.effectNote: The listed +13 includes a +8 racial bonus on Swim checks for hazards and special maneuvers. The shark can take 10 even under threat or distraction and can run while swimming in a straight line.

notes: Feats are Alertness, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative and Iron Will.
Use Will +4 for this SRD printing. The original RTF, and linked HTML reprint give +4. The d20srd.org reprint lists +6, which matches the result of applying Iron Will's +2 bonus.
Organization is solitary, a school of 2–5, or a pack of 6–11. Advancement is 11–17 HD (Huge). The source gives no level adjustment.
The shark circles potential prey before darting in to bite.
